errors.evidence: The chart is a simple bar chart with one bar per category. A grouped bar chart would have multiple bars per category. This description is structurally incorrect.

The description only mentions the specific lease price values for three of the 14 categories (Nordrhein-Westfalen, Saarland, and Deutschland). It omits the other 11 values which are explicitly labeled on the chart.
